coxreg.title: Cox Regression
coxreg.droppedEarly: Censored cases before the earliest event in a stratum
coxreg.devNote: Deviation coding ({{name}}): the reference category is coded −1.
coxreg.simpleNote: Simple coding ({{name}}): each category compared with the reference category.
coxreg.warnSave: /SAVE and /OUTFILE are not available in PSPP Studio; nothing was saved.
coxreg.warnIgnored: {{keyword}} is not available; it was ignored.
coxreg.warnNoEvents: There are no events among the valid cases; the model cannot be estimated.
coxreg.warnStratumNoEvents: Strata without any event were dropped: {{strata}}.
coxreg.warnNoCovariates: No covariates were specified; only the null model is shown.
coxreg.warnAliased: Covariates that are constant or linear combinations of other covariates were removed: {{names}}.
coxreg.warnIterations: Estimation terminated at iteration number {{n}} because the maximum number of iterations has been reached. Final solution cannot be found.
coxreg.warnMonotone: The partial likelihood is monotone in {{names}} (the coefficient grows without bound, e.g. events occur only in one category or in perfect order of the covariate). The estimates and standard errors are not reliable.
coxreg.warnSingular: The information matrix is singular; standard errors cannot be computed.
coxreg.errTime: Exactly one survival time variable is expected (optionally followed by WITH covariates).
coxreg.errInteraction: Interaction terms (a*b, a BY b) and time-dependent covariates are not supported.
coxreg.errStepwise: Stepwise methods (FSTEP, BSTEP, REMOVE) are not available; use METHOD=ENTER.
coxreg.errMethod: Unknown method {{name}} on METHOD; use ENTER.
coxreg.errRole: {{name}} cannot be both a covariate and the time, status or strata variable.
coxreg.errCategorical: {{name}} is not a covariate of the model.
coxreg.errContrast: CONTRAST expects (variable)=INDICATOR, DEVIATION or SIMPLE with an optional reference category number, e.g. CONTRAST(group)=INDICATOR(1).
coxreg.errContrastType: Contrast {{name}} is not available; use INDICATOR, DEVIATION or SIMPLE.
coxreg.errRefcat: The reference category of {{name}} must be between 1 and {{n}}.
coxreg.errCi: CI expects a level between 0 and 100.
coxreg.errCriteria: Unknown or invalid criterion {{name}} on CRITERIA.
coxreg.errPattern: PATTERN expects covariate(value) pairs, e.g. PATTERN=age(50) group(1).
coxreg.errPatternBy: PATTERN … BY expects one categorical covariate that has no value in the pattern.
coxreg.errPatternValue: {{value}} is not an observed category of {{name}}.
